title: Power On
briefing: Welcome to ByteWorks, rookie! I'm Foreman Flo. This old factory hasn't built a computer in years, and it's your job to bring it back to life, one floor at a time. Every machine here is controlled with Python code. First job: flip the main power. The control computer only wakes up when it sees the message Factory online.
hints: print() shows whatever you put between the brackets. Text needs quotes around it: print("hello").
The exact message is Factory online: a capital F, a small o, and no full stop.
Line 3 should be print("Factory online") and line 6 should be print(24 * 7). Numbers don't need quotes!
bonus: Print how many minutes the factory runs in a week (24 * 7 * 60), and how many seconds too.
